about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of France: 18 regions (13 in metropolitan France including Corsica, 5 overseas), one region each. See docs/REGIONS-FR.md, which also reports a local trial build of three départements.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:FR codes: FR-ARA to FR-PAC and FR-20R for metropolitan France; FR-971, FR-972, FR-973, FR-974, FR-976 overseas.
codes.why: A bare FR is not a US code, but the parts after the hyphen are three letters, three digits or 20R, while address index ids must match [A-Z]{2} (engine/setup/manifest.py line 72, engine/setup/install.py line 267). None of them is in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). Départements have numeric codes (FR-14, FR-2A).
codes.verified: Read from Wikipedia's ISO 3166-2:FR page on 2026-11-17 (secondary source). Then checked on ISO's Online Browsing Platform (entry FR), opened in a browser after accepting its terms: all 18 codes are in its list; its change history dates FR-COR to FR-20R to 2020-11-24 and the deletion of FR-GP, FR-MQ, FR-GF, FR-RE and FR-YT to 2021-11-25; FR-971, FR-974 and FR-976 are filed as "overseas departmental collectivity", FR-972 and FR-973 as "overseas unique territorial collectivity" (second check).

terrain.dataset: BD ALTI® v2, 25 m grid, one file per département
terrain.notes: ASCII grid in 7z. Lambert-93 / NGF-IGN69 in metropolitan France; Corsica uses IGN78C heights; each overseas département has its own UTM projection and height datum (download feed titles). A 25 m file is listed for each of the 101 départements in the download feed; only 14, 50 and 61 were tried (93.1 MB of sources, 1,002 tiles). 25 m matches zoom 12 at 49° N.

terrain.dataset: RGE ALTI® v2, 5 m and 1 m

terrain.verified: sizes by HEAD on the AWS mirror 2026-11-17; collection page not re-read
terrain.notes: Surface model. Covers the sea and the Channel Islands, which BD ALTI does not.

water.notes: Edition 2026-09-15, GPKG per département or region. detail_hydrographique holds springs (nature Source and Source captée). Tried for 14, 50 and 61.

One file per territory, not per département. The 2026 folder has a shapefile zip for each of metropolitan France (FXX), Guadeloupe (GLP), Martinique (MTQ), Mayotte (MYT) and La Réunion (REU), and none for Guyane (second check).

dams.dataset: Référentiel des obstacles à l'écoulement (ROE), Métropole
dams.notes: WFS ObstEcoul_FXX, filterable by CdDepartement. River obstacles, not a reservoir inventory: no storage and almost no structure heights. Meaning of CdTypeOuvrage codes not checked. Overseas: Sandre's WFS has ObstEcoul_GLP, _MTQ, _GUF, _REU, _MYT and _all beside _FXX; counts on 2026-11-17 (resultType=hits): 120,038 metropolitan, 113 Guadeloupe, 388 Martinique, 741 Guyane, 140 La Réunion, 156 Mayotte, 125,818 in all (second check, measured). The six territory layers sum to 121,576, and the 4,242 more in _all are rows whose status is "Gelé" (frozen); the other 121,576 are "Validé" (second check, measured).

crops.notes: Vector parcels, one file per region (no per-département file). A 2025 file is listed for each of the 18 regions in the download feed (R11 to R94, R01 to R06); only R28 was tried. Overseas files use local UTM projections. Crop codes per REF_CULTURES_GROUPES_CULTURES_2025.csv. No apple-specific code.
Latest edition, classes and download not checked.

buildings.notes: Footprints with height in metres. Edition 2026-09-15 is listed for each of the 101 départements in the download feed. Tried for 14, 50 and 61: height for 97.9 % of 1,539,916 buildings. hauteur runs from the lowest ground point to the top of the eaves (the roof edge, or the top of the wall under a flat roof), not to the ridge (BD TOPO 3.5 content description, July 2026; second check).

buildings.licence: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 per its README; ODbL per Overture
buildings.notes: Format tools/build_buildings.py already reads; heights mostly missing.

places.dataset: BD TOPO® v3.5: commune, commune_associee_ou_deleguee, zone_d_habitation, lieu_dit_non_habite, zone_d_activite_ou_d_interet
places.notes: Communes with population, delegated and associated communes, named hamlets.

places.dataset: Code officiel géographique 2026; populations de référence 2023

addresses.dataset: Base Adresse Nationale (BAN), CSV per département
addresses.notes: Updated daily. Separate repetition index (rep), former commune, AFNOR form. Files exist for 971 to 976, 2A and 2B (HEAD). 26,123,035 address numbers in the commune summary of 2026-11-17, all territories. Tried for 14, 50 and 61.

addresses.publisher: Overture Maps Foundation, from the BAN through OpenAddresses
addresses.notes: country = FR, 26,052,116 rows; the same BAN, about a month older. Release 2026-10-21.0 (second check, measured with DuckDB): every FR row has a five-digit postcode; postal_city is empty in every row and address_levels has one entry, the commune, so tools/build_addresses.py as written would store an empty city and the commune's first two letters as the state (351 values, 6,894,553 rows or 26 % equal to a real US code); 7.8 % of numbers carry a suffix, mostly fused ("12bis"); sources[0].dataset names the département (fr/59, fr/2A), an exact cut without postcodes. The five overseas regions are under FR, as are Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin and Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon; no rows under GP, MQ, GF, RE or YT.

192,233 records in the tabular API copy, date of copy unknown.

not_open_nationwide: NF Z 10-011 addressing standard (AFNOR, sold; read only through La Poste's specification)
BSS EAU water points (BRGM): licence "not specified" on data.gouv.fr
BNPE abstraction works (Hub'Eau): points at the commune centroid or of unknown precision; licence not checked

A national list of fire stations: none found (Calvados publishes its own); BD TOPO's zone_d_activite_ou_d_interet holds 6,710 fire and rescue centres under Licence Ouverte 2.0, see pois (second check, measured)
A national list of public drinking water points, shelters or SAIP sirens: none found

postal_code.format: Five digits. The first two are usually the département; Corsica uses 20, overseas départements three digits (971 to 976). A postcode can serve several communes and a commune can have several postcodes. 23 metropolitan communes use a neighbouring département's prefix, 6 of them across a region boundary (geo.api.gouv.fr, 2026-11-17).

addressing.order: Number, optional repetition index (bis, ter, a letter), street type and name; then postcode and commune on the last line ("14 bis Rue Écuyère, 14000 Caen").
addressing.notes: normalize() and norm() keep only a-z and 0-9 ("Église" becomes "glise"); the postcode is read only as the last word; a final word such as me, ri or il is taken for a US state (Bellême, Ri, Bonnœil); tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US'. Checked in this repository on 2026-11-17. The trial index declares meta.country = 'FR' and is searched with its own rules.
